name: Yongkang

queries.query: 永康市 不动产登记 地籍图 查询 地图 官方
queries.result: Discovery identified the official Yongkang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and an official Yongkang Real Estate Registration Center annual report. The materials describe cadastral/real-estate registration duties and public information services, but no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was verified.

registryBasis: Official Yongkang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau guidance identifies the municipal bureau as the information custodian; the official Yongkang Real Estate Registration Center report states that the center handles land/real-estate registration, cadastral investigation support, archives, and lawful public information query services.

source.name: Zhejiang official geographic-information public-service platform and Yongkang local registry custodian
source.operator: 永康市自然资源和规划局 / 永康市不动产登记中心; Zhejiang official geographic-information public-service platform
source.serviceType: Official local registry custodian and provincial public GIS discovery route; anonymous parcel geometry not verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The local bureau and registration center administer Yongkang municipal natural-resource, cadastral, and real-estate registration information; the provincial platform advertises public geographic-information map services.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official pages and reports were discoverable, but the direct bounded fetch of the provincial platform timed out before current JavaScript/configuration, service endpoints, schema, CRS, or parcel responses could be inspected.

technicalBlocker: A TLS-verified anonymous GET to https://ditu.zjzwfw.gov.cn/platform-main/index.html timed out after 20 seconds in the request environment. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, TLS weakening, or unsafe fields were used. A timed-out map request is not evidence of parcel absence.
remainingUncertainty: The current provincial GIS application's JavaScript/configuration, endpoint structure, access policy, schema/CRS, stable native parcel identity, and exact-point coverage remain unknown. The official local custodian is evidenced, but no citywide open parcel feature service was established.
nextStep: Hold runtime integration. A later researcher may qualify an anonymous first-party parcel endpoint only after independently verifying schema, CRS, stable native identity, and safe ID-plus-geometry output.
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement point; not shifted to force a parcel hit.
